description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for MongoDB connections within the Eclipse Ditto project, including options for query time, URI, connection pool, circuit breaker, and monitoring.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for MongoDB connection.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.MongoDbConfigValue
classes.description: Enum of known configuration values and default settings for MongoDbConfig.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.OptionsConfig
classes.description: Interface for MongoDB options configuration, including SSL and read preference.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.OptionsConfig.OptionsConfigValue
classes.description: Enum of known options configuration values.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.ConnectionPoolConfig
classes.description: Interface for connection pool settings such as max size and wait times.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.ConnectionPoolConfig.ConnectionPoolConfigValue
classes.description: Enum of connection pool configuration parameters.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.CircuitBreakerConfig
classes.description: Interface for circuit breaker settings including max failures and timeout.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.CircuitBreakerConfig.TimeoutConfig
classes.description: Interface for circuit breaker timeout configuration.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.MonitoringConfig
classes.description: Interface for monitoring settings such as command and connection pool monitoring.

methods.name: getMongoDbUri
methods.description: Retrieves the MongoDB URI based on configuration.

methods.name: getOptionsConfig
methods.description: Returns the options configuration for MongoDB.
